messages:
Evan R: Heads-up: customer wants a joint announcement with an SI + HW vendor + marketplace listing. need a clear rule on who leads comms, how pipeline credit flows, and conflict handling before we greenlight.
Sasha M: big +1. typical approach: AE owns customer comms, SI owns technical case-study, press ops owns public release cadence. but conflict emerges when multiple SIs want credit or HW vendor requests exclusivity.
Jules P: propose a lightweight policy:
1) AE confirms participation and public reference consent.
2) SI nominated by AE gets technical quote & co-marketing.
3) Marketplace listing launch aligned but separate SKU marketing.
4) No exclusivity without legal OK + partner contract.
Ravi G: practical enforcement ideas: add a "coannounce_owner" field in claim metadata and a short arbitration window. sketch: ```text
if multi_SI_interest:
  open ops-window 48h for partner bids
  if SI_contracts.include(exclusive_flag) -> legal review
  winner = highest_score_or_ae_nomination
```
marketplace-bot: Announcement request created: "OrbitCloud + Orion SI + NorthPeak HW" -> ann-req-2182. Notified: #partnerships @pressops. :mega:
Sasha M: timeline: request -> ops arbitration (48h) -> draft assets (7d) -> legal & privacy checks (3d) -> embargo release. include a 2-week runway for co-marketing assets.
Jules P: what about pipeline credit? recommend primary credit to AE per CRM; partner co-sell credit recorded as partner influence tag + opportunity split in CRM. ops will publish a post-announce attribution note.
Ravi G: edge-case: SI wants to be first public responder (quotes) but HW vendor demands embargo until their certification. ops should capture embargo_deadline in ann-req metadata and enforce.
Evan R: can pressops-bot handle a check-list automation? e.g., assets present, legal sign-off, embargo date, contact list.
pressops-bot: Checklist created for ann-req-2182: assets_pending, legal_pending, embargo=2026-04-30, contacts=[AE:Carla, SI:Jamal, HW:Arun]. Automations: reminder @48h and @7d. :clipboard:
Sasha M: also require a quick QA step with Eng-ML if the announcement includes performance claims (latency/cost). add a verification flag.
Jules P: good call. add a short example flow in the README we send to partners: 1) partner expresses interest -> 48h broker -> AE nomination or ops selection -> draft -> sign-off -> embargo -> release.
Ravi G: I'll add arbitration logic to the ann-service and ensure it annotates CRM opps with partner_influence tags. opening PR: https://git.internal/redwood/ann-service/pull/54
Evan R: please include a sample email template for multi-SI situations that asks partners to confirm interest + exclusivity requests within 48h.
Jules P: will draft templates and the partner-facing FAQ. aim to publish policy + templates before vendor sync next Wed.
Sasha M: thanks team. once policy live, we'll run a mock announce with a non-customer demo to exercise the flow. :rocket:
